scepter.en: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.
scepter.zh: 提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。

scepter.en: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within 5s burns an additional 20% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.
scepter.zh: 施放闪烁后，5秒内的下一次法力损毁将额外燃烧20%最大魔法值，并且阻止目标在短时间内恢复或获得魔法。这个负面状态无法驱散。

shard.en: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
shard.zh: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。

shard.en: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
shard.zh: 狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。

shard.en: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
shard.zh: 多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。

scepter.en: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
scepter.zh: 反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。

shard.en: Reduces cooldown by 4. Causes Brain Sap to become a 550 AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for 30%.
shard.zh: 减少4秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成550作用范围的技能。次级目标只有30%治疗效果。

scepter.en: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by 35s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 200% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.
scepter.zh: 魔爪的冷却时间减少35秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受200%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

shard.en: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal 1.5% of the target's max health as Pure damage.
shard.zh: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成1.5%目标最大生命值的纯粹伤害。

scepter.en: Increases initial damage and grants 2 Rupture Charges. Decreases cooldown by 10s.
scepter.zh: 提升初始伤害，并且提供2点割裂能量点数。冷却时间减少10秒。

desc.en: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 425 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
desc.zh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近425范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。

scepter.en: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 2s.
scepter.zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低75%。冰爆总数提升20%。对极寒领域内停留超过2秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

scepter.en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
scepter.zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

desc.en: Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her. The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
desc.zh: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。 山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。

shard.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
shard.zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

scepter.en: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there. Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
scepter.zh: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。

scepter.en: Allows Juggernaut to attack his enemies during Blade Fury even while moving. These attacks deal 75% damage and Item Potency.
scepter.zh: 主宰可以在剑刃风暴期间攻击敌人，即使移动也可以攻击，攻击会造成75%伤害和物品威力。

shard.en: Increases ward healing and health.
shard.zh: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

scepter.en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
scepter.zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

shard.en: Grants +1 Leap charge.
shard.zh: 获得+1跳跃能量点数。

shard.en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard.zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

shard.en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard.zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

scepter.en: While Morph is active, every time Morphling casts a unit-targeted spell, 2 lesser replicants appear one after another 0.2 seconds apart, and cast it again at a nearby target, or the same target if no other valid targets are available. Every echo is weaker, dealing less damage, healing less health, and applying shorter buffs/debuffs than the previous one.
scepter.zh: 变形生效时，变体精灵每次施放指向性技能，都会有2个弱化复制体每隔0.2秒后出现，对附近的一个目标再次施放，或者没有其他有效目标时对同个目标再次施放。

shard.en: Cooldown reduced by 2s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking 12% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少2秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的12%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

scepter.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

scepter.en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every 600 units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter.zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋600距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

shard.en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to 8 seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by 15% during this invisibility.
shard.zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续8秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升15%。

shard.en: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
shard.zh: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

scepter.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的90%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

shard.en: Increases range. When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.
shard.zh: 提升距离。肉钩击中敌人时会根据拖行的距离造成额外伤害。

scepter.en: Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.
scepter.zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升200，伤害提升90点，并且可以降低敌人的20%生命回复。

shard.en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is 2x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by 2s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
shard.zh: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为2倍，打击冷却时间减少2秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

scepter.en: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
scepter.zh: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

scepter.en: Increases Cast Range. Sand King leaves behind a trail of spines, that, after a 0.8s delay, create Stinger attack areas along the path, that apply 70% of Stinger damage to enemies hit.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离。沙王会留下一串尖刺，在0.8秒延迟后沿着路径制造尾螫的攻击，对击中的敌人施加70%尾螫伤害。

shard.en: Every 3s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
shard.zh: 每3秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。

scepter.en: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
scepter.zh: 电子涡流变成范围型技能，可以作用于风暴之灵周围所有敌人。

shard.en: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes 3 Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.
shard.zh: 施放后风暴之灵和附近友方英雄获得3次超负荷效果。提供额外攻击速度。持续最多12秒，或效果用尽。

scepter.en: Increases cast range to 780 and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
scepter.zh: 施法距离提升至780，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成180点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

shard.en: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a 350 physical damage barrier.
shard.zh: 提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供350点物理伤害护盾。

desc.en: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
desc.zh: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。

shard.en: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.
shard.zh: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

shard.en: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
shard.zh: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的75%魔法箭施法距离内。

scepter.en: Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells. If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
scepter.zh: 提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。 复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

desc.en: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
desc.zh: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。

desc.en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
desc.zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。

desc.en: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
desc.zh: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。

desc.en: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
desc.zh: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。

scepter.en: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side, plus 2 straight ahead, that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
scepter.zh: 幽灵船在目标地点以2.5秒的间隔产生2艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷各发射3波炮弹，同时正前方发射2波，穿过敌人时造成40%幽灵船伤害。

desc.en: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance.
desc.zh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。

shard.en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
shard.zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

shard.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to 2 additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance while channeling.
shard.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多2个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得60%魔法抗性。

scepter.en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
scepter.zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

scepter.en: Increase cast range. Every 0.9 seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within 600 of the target for 100% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within 2000 units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每0.9秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于600范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为100%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近2000范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

desc.en: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and pip health there that lasts 15s.
desc.zh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的攻击力和生命格数为平常群蛇守卫的4倍，持续15秒。

shard.en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
shard.zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。

scepter.en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line. Decreases cooldown.
scepter.zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

desc.en: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor has 4 pip health.
desc.zh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚350距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至100，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚拥有4格生命。

desc.en: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.
desc.zh: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。

scepter.en: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
scepter.zh: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。

scepter.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
scepter.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域400范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

desc.en: Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. When destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it. Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 pip if there are no other enemies in range. Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 pip.
desc.zh: 在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。 连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1格伤害。 巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱1格生命。

shard.en: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by 5 and cannot be targeted by their allies.
shard.zh: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低5点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

scepter.en: Increases Cast Range to 900. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have 15% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts 1s longer and does an additional 2 attacks.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离至900。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有15%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升1秒，并且额外发动2次攻击。

shard.en: Increases Malefice stun duration by 0.3s and creates an Eidolon next to enemy Hero targets every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.
shard.zh: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加0.3秒，并且每次眩晕都会在敌方英雄目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

scepter.en: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to 4% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a 1000 AoE. Pulls at a rate of 150.
scepter.zh: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位4%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个1000范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为150。

scepter.en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by 9% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
scepter.zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少9%（可以叠加）。

scepter.en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
scepter.zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

scepter.en: Turrets missiles have 20% faster attack interval, increased range, and increased speed.
scepter.zh: 炮塔导弹的攻击间隔加快20%，射程和速度均有所提高。

desc.en: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, slowing them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 3 seconds. The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
desc.zh: 向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且减速，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续3秒。 目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。

desc.en: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
desc.zh: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。

scepter.en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
scepter.zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。

scepter.en: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 45% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
scepter.zh: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的45%。

desc.en: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
desc.zh: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。

shard.en: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every 2 seconds that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
shard.zh: 持续施法时每2秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续15秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

scepter.en: Calls 2 Golems.
scepter.zh: 召唤2个地狱火。

shard.en: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
shard.zh: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

desc.en: Beastmaster calls forth an Ancient Thunderhide to fight alongside him. The Thunderhide can Slam the ground to damage and slow nearby enemies, and beats its Thunderhide Drum as Beastmaster or Beastmaster's units attack, increasing their damage and max health.
desc.zh: 兽王召唤一只远古雷肤兽与他并肩作战。雷肤兽可以猛击地面，对附近的敌人造成伤害并使其减速。兽王或兽王的单位进行攻击时，雷肤兽会敲响雷肤兽战鼓，提升他们的攻击力和最大生命值。

scepter.en: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 300 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
scepter.zh: 暗影突袭变为300范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。

shard.en: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals 125 damage in a 300 AoE and silences the target for 1.75 seconds.
shard.zh: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在300范围内造成125点伤害，并沉默1.75秒。

shard.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed by 25%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, 2 Plague Wards are created around them.
shard.zh: 施法距离和弹道速度提升25%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造2个瘟疫守卫。

scepter.en: Decreases cooldown by 35 seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
scepter.zh: 冷却时间减少35秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

scepter.en: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
scepter.zh: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

shard.en: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
shard.zh: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。

desc.en: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
desc.zh: 时间漫游落地后1.5秒内可使用。施放时，自身将逆转时间漫游，回到上一个施放地点。不会影响生命值或触发神杖效果。

shard.en: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take 75% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a 3 second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.
shard.zh: 本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在3秒延迟后再次受到75%原攻击伤害的纯粹伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。

scepter.en: Reduces cooldown.
scepter.zh: 减少冷却时间。

shard.en: Crypt Swarm has 2 charges with a 1s cooldown between uses. Crypt Swarm slows enemies by 100% for 0.5s.
shard.zh: 地穴虫群拥有2点能量点数，每次使用之间有1秒冷却时间。地穴虫群会使敌人减速100%，持续0.5秒。

scepter.en: Spirit Siphon steals 120 attack speed from each afflicted enemy hero. Spirit Siphon drains an additional 2% of the target's maximum health per second.
scepter.zh: 吸魂巫术从每个受影响的敌方英雄身上窃取120攻击速度。吸魂巫术额外每秒吸取目标2%最大生命值。

desc.en: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
desc.zh: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。

shard.en: Increases cast range to 375.
shard.zh: 施法距离提升至375。

shard.en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within 700 units of the ward for 75% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近700范围内所有敌方英雄，造成75%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

shard.en: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
shard.zh: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

desc.en: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
desc.zh: 持续施法 - 圣堂刺客经过2秒持续施法后可以传送至任意灵能陷阱，到达时引爆灵能陷阱，陷阱总是最大效果，并且立刻造成400点额外伤害。灵能投射在持续施法时不会脱离隐匿效果。

scepter.en: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
scepter.zh: 现在陷阱引爆后还会沉默受到作用的敌人。

shard.en: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.
shard.zh: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

scepter.en: Corrosive Skin applies 4x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within 500 distance of Viper. Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to 50% increased effect after 4s.
scepter.zh: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙500范围内的敌人施加4倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在4秒后，达到最高的50%提升。

desc.en: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
desc.zh: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且500范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续4秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。

shard.en: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains 20% bonus movement speed.
shard.zh: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得20%移动速度加成。

scepter.en: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
scepter.zh: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。

desc.en: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
desc.zh: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。

scepter.en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
scepter.zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

scepter.en: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
scepter.zh: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为100%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

desc.en: Only active during Nothl Projection. Dazzle pulls his body through the Nothl Realm to his spirit. Nothl Projection ends upon return. Cannot be cast if Dazzle's body is rooted or leashed.
desc.zh: 仅在虚无投影期间生效。戴泽使他的身体穿过虚无之境，拉向他的灵魂。虚无投影在返回时结束。 如果戴泽的身体被缠绕或束缚则无法施放。

shard.en: Increases Nothl Projection's cast range by 200 and leash range by 450.
shard.zh: 虚无投影的施法距离提升200，束缚距离提升450。

desc.en: Supercharges Clockwerk's abilities: Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range. Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased. Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target. Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased. Jetpack: Moves faster. Clockwerk's movement and attack speed become slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
desc.zh: 使发条技师的所有技能变得强力： 弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。 能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。 照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。 发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。 喷气背包：移动得更快。 持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。

desc.en: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
desc.zh: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。

shard.en: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location 2 additional times, with a 5 second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by 45. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
shard.zh: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复2次，重复间隔为5秒。每次作用范围增加45。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

desc.en: Leshrac emits an aura that disarms and constantly dispels nearby enemy units. Leshrac also constantly dispels himself. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
desc.zh: 拉席克散发出一个光环，会缴械并持续驱散。附近敌方单位。拉席克也会持续驱散自身。 驱散类型：弱驱散

desc.en: Nature's Prophet and his treants curse enemies they attack, slowing them and dealing damage per second. Curses from different attackers stack. Each attacker's curse has an independent duration that can be refreshed by further attacks from the same unit that applied it.
desc.zh: 自然先知和他的树人诅咒他们攻击的敌人，减缓他们的移动速度并造成每秒伤害。不同攻击者的诅咒效果可以叠加。每个攻击者的诅咒拥有独立的持续时间，同个单位的后续攻击会刷新相应诅咒的持续时间。

scepter.en: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from 1.5s up to 3s seconds at max bounce.
scepter.zh: 缠绕所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从1.5秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为3秒。

scepter.en: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to 20s. Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至20秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。

shard.en: Infest explosion applies a 3s duration Open Wounds to enemies in the damage radius. Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
shard.zh: 感染爆炸会对伤害范围内的敌人施加持续3秒的撕裂伤口效果。吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。

shard.en: Surged units leave behind a 150 radius trail that lasts 7s, slows enemies around it by 35% and deals 40 damage per second in 0.5s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
shard.zh: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为150，持续7秒，对附近的敌人造成35%减速，并且每秒造成40点伤害，伤害间隔为0.5秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

desc.en: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.
desc.zh: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去3秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和眩晕。移动1100距离以上将造成最大威力。

desc.en: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
desc.zh: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。

desc.en: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.
desc.zh: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。

shard.en: After a 3s delay, the target is Purified again with 65% effectiveness.
shard.zh: 3秒延迟后目标会再次受到65%威力的洗礼。

scepter.en: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.
scepter.zh: 守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

scepter.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

desc.en: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.
desc.zh: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+100范围内最远的2个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。

desc.en: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.
desc.zh: 魅惑魔女缠绕一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续6秒。

shard.en: Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard.zh: 哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。 驱散类型：弱驱散

scepter.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
scepter.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

shard.en: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
shard.zh: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。

shard.en: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by 4% every 1s.
shard.zh: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每1秒提升4%。

desc.en: Broodmother may create up to 5 invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time. Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered. Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
desc.zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多5个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。

scepter.en: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

desc.en: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
desc.zh: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是0.5秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。

shard.en: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last 4.6 seconds. 0.2s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within 1200 range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
shard.zh: 缩地在造成伤害的敌人身上留下一个标记，持续4.6秒。编织者脱离缩地状态0.2秒后，附近1200范围内拥有印记的敌人都会被连击的第二次攻击击中。

desc.en: Weaver warps an allied Hero backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier - restoring the HP and mana it had at that time. Shares a cooldown with Time Lapse. DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
desc.zh: 编织者使友军回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。与时光倒流共享冷却时间。 驱散类型：强驱散

scepter.en: Decreases cooldown.
scepter.zh: 减少冷却时间。

shard.en: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
shard.zh: 杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。

shard.en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
shard.zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

scepter.en: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by 60%.
scepter.zh: 提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速60%。

shard.en: Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit. Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
shard.zh: 粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。 粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。

scepter.en: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within 650 units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
scepter.zh: 燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近650范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。

shard.en: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.
shard.zh: 神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。

scepter.en: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to 110/90/70s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to 6 seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with 60% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by 200%.
scepter.zh: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至110/90/70秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多6秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有60%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升200%。

shard.en: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by 50% of its base values for 5s. Cooldown 25. Manacost 50.
shard.zh: 折射可以主动施放，吸收和反弹的伤害比例提升50%，持续5秒。冷却时间为25秒。魔法消耗为50点。

scepter.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a 400 area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for 2s and have their movement speed slowed by 50%. Reduces cooldown by 20s.
scepter.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近400范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑2秒，并且移动速度降低50%。 冷却时间减少20秒。

scepter.en: Removes cooldown.
scepter.zh: 移除了冷却时间。

shard.en: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for 50% of the duration.
shard.zh: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足眩晕时间的50%。

shard.en: Devour has 2 charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have 15% increased AoE and 40% increased spell amplification.
shard.zh: 吞噬拥有2点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有15%额外作用范围和40%额外技能增强。

scepter.en: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a 350 radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
scepter.zh: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。末日作用下目标350范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

shard.en: Earthshock applies 3 Fury Swipes to enemies hit.
shard.zh: 震撼大地对击中的敌人施加3层怒意狂击。

scepter.en: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.
scepter.zh: 减少冷却时间，而且熊战士可以在被控制的状态下使用激怒。

scepter.en: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive 20% damage), and the original target takes 25% of Greater Bash's damage again.
scepter.zh: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到20%伤害），并且原目标再次受到25%的巨力重击伤害。

desc.en: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
desc.zh: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。

scepter.en: Greatly increases knockback.
scepter.zh: 大幅提升击退效果。

shard.en: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a 700 area of effect after 1 second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
shard.zh: 追踪导弹现在从施放1秒后开始不断发射700作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。

desc.en: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a 700 unit radius every 1.3s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
desc.zh: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每1.3秒对矮人直升机附近700范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。

desc.en: Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
desc.zh: 炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。 驱散类型：弱驱散

scepter.en: Grants 1 current and max level.
scepter.zh: 提供1级当前和最高等级。

scepter.en: Grants 1 current and max level.
scepter.zh: 提供1级当前和最高等级。

scepter.en: Grants 1 current and max level.
scepter.zh: 提供1级当前和最高等级。

shard.en: Ghost Walk now also applies 1.25x the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.
shard.zh: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加1.25倍寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。

scepter.en: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a 150 radius every 0.25 seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
scepter.zh: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于冰的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每0.25秒在150范围内基于雷的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）

shard.en: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at 125 units per second.
shard.zh: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒125距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。

scepter.en: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a 90 second cooldown. Creates 2 visible 75% damage Sun Strikes within 90-180 range of each enemy hero.
scepter.zh: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为90秒。每个敌方英雄附近90-180范围内产生2个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有75%伤害。

shard.en: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
shard.zh: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。

scepter.en: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a 150 width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than 2.5 seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.
scepter.zh: 寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道150宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过2.5秒的敌方英雄会基于冰的等级被缠绕并受到魔法伤害。

shard.en: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce 1 time to a random enemy within 450 range and increases intelligence steal.
shard.zh: 使智慧之刃向450范围内的随机敌人弹射1次，并提升智力窃取。

scepter.en: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
scepter.zh: 全领域静默在全领域静默的持续时间内对英雄施加奥术诅咒。

shard.en: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at 70% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
shard.zh: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以70%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。

scepter.en: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.
scepter.zh: 提升最大魔法值转为护盾的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于20%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每80秒只能触发一次。

shard.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
shard.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。

desc.en: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. While shapeshifted this way, the target counts as a unit under Lycan's control for Pack Hunter.
desc.zh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身的效果。变身后目标也被视为狼人控制下的单位，可以享受狼群猎手的效果。

scepter.en: Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities. Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.
scepter.zh: 元素分离获得1级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。 元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。

desc.en: Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
desc.zh: 净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。 驱散类型：弱驱散

scepter.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain 2 charges.
scepter.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得2点能量点数。

scepter.en: Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
scepter.zh: 缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加5层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。

shard.en: Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard.zh: 施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。 驱散类型：弱驱散

shard.en: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals Chaos Knight's full damage and has 25% item potency.
shard.zh: 混乱之箭会制造一个混沌之军的幻象来攻击目标。这个幻象继承混沌骑士的全额攻击力，拥有25%物品威力。

scepter.en: Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 50% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control. When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
scepter.zh: 增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有50%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。 施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。

desc.en: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 4s. Restores 50% of his max health over that duration. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
desc.zh: 挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续4秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的50%。被缠绕时无法施放。 驱散类型：弱驱散

shard.en: Divided We Stand can be cast to pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming Meepo and disabling them. Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing enemies within 200 radius of the impact. If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped if not thrown in time.
shard.zh: 分则能成可以主动施放，抓起目标友方米波或非英雄单位，使米波被缴械，或者非英雄单位被控制。使用子技能可以把抓起的单位向目标扔出，对落点200范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。 如果抓起的目标是米波，它会和携带者共享伤害。抓起目标后如果没有及时扔出将会放下。

desc.en: Throws the Meepo or creep carried by Divided We Stand at the target, dealing damage in a 200 radius and slowing on impact. If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped after 5 seconds.
desc.zh: 把分则能成抓起的米波或非英雄单位扔向目标，对击中的200范围造成伤害和减速。 如果抓起的目标是米波，它会和携带者共享伤害。抓起的目标会在5秒后被放下。

desc.en: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
desc.zh: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续360秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。

scepter.en: Decreases Cooldown to 85/75/65 seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for 16 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 345, 100% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.
scepter.zh: 冷却时间降低至85/75/65秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续16秒。变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定345，100%力量加成，并且拥有在300范围内造成60%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。

scepter.en: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by 1s and increasing cast speed by 25%.
scepter.zh: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少1秒，施法速度提升25%。

desc.en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
desc.zh: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成150 + 1.5倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的35%。

desc.en: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
desc.zh: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来3次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。

scepter.en: Increases strength steal.
scepter.zh: 提升力量窃取。

desc.en: Undying sinks his teeth into his target, dealing his attack damage plus bonus physical damage and healing himself for the amount dealt. Biting a hero turns them into a zombie for 3s: becoming melee, silenced, 25% slowed, and dealing 40% less damage. Bitten creeps die and become a controllable zombie for 20s.
desc.zh: 不朽尸王用牙齿咬住目标，造成攻击伤害加上额外物理伤害，并治疗自身相同伤害量的生命。 被咬的英雄会将其变成僵尸，持续3秒：变为近战，被沉默，减速25%，并且造成的伤害减少40%。被咬的非英雄单位会阵亡，再变成可以控制的僵尸，持续20秒。

shard.en: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to 600 and throw delay is reduced to 0.5 seconds.
shard.zh: 可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至600，投掷延迟降低至0.5秒。

scepter.en: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
scepter.zh: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。

shard.en: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
shard.zh: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。

shard.en: Causes enemies that touch the field to be struck by Electromagnetic Repulsion with 50% reduced knockback.
shard.zh: 使接触力场的敌人被电磁排斥击中，击退距离减少50%。

desc.en: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass. Enemies touching the wall are struck by Electromagnetic Repulsion with 0% reduced knockback.
desc.zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。触碰墙壁的敌人会被电磁斥力打击，击退距离减少0%。

scepter.en: Mutes items.
scepter.zh: 锁闭物品。

desc.en: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources, and Scarab Metabolism is always active at 3x strength.
desc.zh: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是隐身状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。

shard.en: Decreases cooldown by 10s. For the first 15s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.
shard.zh: 冷却时间减少10秒。在复仇的最初15秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。

scepter.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed. Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对减益免疫单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加破坏效果。

shard.en: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.
shard.zh: 海妖之歌范围内友军每秒会恢复一定百分比的生命和魔法。

shard.en: Grants 2 charges.
shard.zh: 获得2点能量点数。

desc.en: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
desc.zh: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。

shard.en: Increases illuminate heal.
shard.zh: 提升冲击波的治疗效果。

shard.en: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for 50% of the damage done.
shard.zh: 羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复50%造成伤害。

scepter.en: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.
scepter.zh: 每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。

shard.en: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to 25% of your health.
shard.zh: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复25%生命值。

scepter.en: Provides charges and increases range.
scepter.zh: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。

desc.en: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
desc.zh: 在目标地点创造一团云雾。作用范围内所有友军为隐藏状态，受到暗影之舞的作用。

scepter.en: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
scepter.zh: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

desc.en: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.
desc.zh: 美杜莎受到指向性技能作用后会对该敌人放出单体的秘术异蛇，把他们变成石头，持续1秒。

scepter.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter.zh: 旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。 驱散类型：弱驱散

scepter.en: Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter.zh: 旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。 驱散类型：弱驱散

shard.en: Grants Troll 16% + 3% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus 175 when attacking an enemy unit.
shard.zh: 巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有16% + 热血战魂叠加次数*3%的几率对远程攻击距离 + 175范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。

shard.en: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of 5 stacks.
shard.zh: 双刃剑可以对敌人造成减速，并且每击中一名英雄都会暂时提升半人马战行者的力量值。每次叠加都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加5次。

desc.en: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
desc.zh: 半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。

shard.en: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
shard.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
desc.zh: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空0.6秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。

scepter.en: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and 150 damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw 100 + 75 barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within 450 radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of 800. After 8 seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within 450 radius equal to 200 + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.
scepter.zh: 活性护甲可以主动施放，获得最大叠加次数和150点生命的护盾。护盾的恢复速度为每秒100 + 伐木机450范围内每名敌方英雄都会增加75，最高为800。8秒后伐木机会对450范围内每个英雄造成伤害，数值为200 + 护盾剩余生命，而且失去全部护盾。

desc.en: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
desc.zh: 伐木机向面朝的方向放出一道火焰。施加一个负面效果，造成每秒伤害，并减缓敌人的移动速度。对建筑造成的伤害有所减少。

scepter.en: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40%.
scepter.zh: 钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，0.5秒后以0.4秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出5次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓-40%。

desc.en: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
desc.zh: 向目标地点咳出一团满是刺针的毛团。毛团会在该地点爆开，范围内的敌人都将受到多个鼻液叠加效果和单次刺针扫射的作用。

desc.en: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
desc.zh: 巨牙海民伸出手来触碰友方单位，拉近彼此。触碰后巨牙海民和他的友军获得移动速度和护甲加成。

desc.en: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.
desc.zh: 将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成眩晕，伤害和减速。另外对落地区域250范围内所有英雄造成伤害。飞踢非英雄单位会使冷却时间减少50%。

shard.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, 3 bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
shard.zh: 天怒法师施放奥法鹰隼时，会产生3个鹰隼，其中一个飞往原目标，而另外的两个飞往原目标附近500范围内随机敌人。以英雄为首要目标。

scepter.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter.zh: 天怒法师施放震荡光弹时，会随机对原目标附近500范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

scepter.en: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
scepter.zh: 天怒法师施放上古封印时，会随机对原目标附近500范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

scepter.en: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
scepter.zh: 天怒法师施放神秘之耀时，原目标附近500范围内另一个敌人的位置上也会产生一个神秘之耀。以英雄为首要目标。

scepter.en: Mist Coil affects all units in a 400 radius around the target. When Mist Coil hits enemies, Abaddon deals 100% of his attack damage and applies on-hit effects with 80% Item Potency.
scepter.zh: 迷雾缠绕会影响目标附近400范围内的所有单位。 迷雾缠绕击中敌人时，亚巴顿会造成100%攻击伤害，并施加拥有80%物品威力的击中效果。

shard.en: 75% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
shard.zh: 会对附近敌人造成吸收伤害的75%。

shard.en: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.
shard.zh: 减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。

scepter.en: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for 2 seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.
scepter.zh: 游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得2秒减益免疫状态和50%魔法抗性提升。

shard.en: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.
shard.zh: 压倒性优势的范围更大，会根据对敌方英雄造成的伤害提供全伤害护盾。

scepter.en: Increases movement speed and becomes an 500 area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.
scepter.zh: 提升移动速度，变为500范围型技能，而且使用时总是会作用于军团指挥官。

scepter.en: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
scepter.zh: 如果军团指挥官在决斗中获胜，会在她周围自动触发强攻。

desc.en: Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds. When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
desc.zh: 在指定地点放置警示牌，使作用范围内的感应地雷为无敌状态，并且造成的伤害增加15%。同一时间只能存在一个标识。持续240秒。 敌方英雄进入标识的200范围内时标识附近整个1000范围变成一片雷区，持续10秒。敌方单位在区域内移动都会受到伤害。雷区持续时间结束后标识会被摧毁。

scepter.en: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
scepter.zh: 提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。

shard.en: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
shard.zh: 灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。

shard.en: Decreases cooldown to 10s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.
shard.zh: 冷却时间减少至10秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。

desc.en: Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way. Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
desc.zh: 大地之灵对一名英雄施法，使其暂时获得残岩的属性。经过短时间后残岩就会碎裂，释放出英雄，并对周围单位造成伤害。 可以对残岩施放。对残岩施放时冷却时间为5秒。 对友方英雄施放时施法距离更远。

shard.en: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around. The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.
shard.zh: 火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。

scepter.en: Summons a Pit of Malice around the furthermost of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
scepter.zh: 在远端的传送门处召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。

desc.en: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
desc.zh: 施放需消耗恐怖利刃当前生命值的一部分，为恐怖利刃和他附近的幻象提供生命恢复、移动和攻击速度加成。不会影响倒影的幻象。魔化状态下无法施放，而且施放魔化会移除狂魔效果。

desc.en: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
desc.zh: 放出一道能量波，朝所有方向向外行进，击中敌方英雄将使其恐惧并造成伤害，同时恐怖利刃短时间内获得魔化状态。

shard.en: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
shard.zh: 超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。

scepter.en: Increases Supernova's pip health and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.
scepter.zh: 超新星的生命格数增加，凤凰可以对友方英雄施放超新星，使双方共同进入恒星进行重生。

desc.en: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
desc.zh: 在目标范围内降下大雨。站在该区域的敌人受到每秒伤害，并且治疗增强被削弱。区域内友军被治疗，并且具有治疗增强效果。

scepter.en: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
scepter.zh: 严寒烧灼变成开关型技能，开启后每秒消耗一定量魔法。提升寒冬飞龙的移动速度。

shard.en: Reduces cooldown by 4 seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.
shard.zh: 冷却时间减少4秒。友方单位从冰茧解冻后获得额外攻击力。

scepter.en: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.
scepter.zh: 目标落单时乱流具有沉默效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

shard.en: The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for 12s when created. Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
shard.zh: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续12秒。 不会触发神符灌注。

shard.en: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with 35% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the target position and Primal Spring damage is dealt around the jump area instead.
shard.zh: 擎天一击对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的35%。擎天一击设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至目标地点，对落点附近造成乾坤之跃的伤害。

scepter.en: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
scepter.zh: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。

scepter.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

shard.en: Cursed Crown creates 4 brambles in a 175 radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.
shard.zh: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在175范围内产生4朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。

scepter.en: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.
scepter.zh: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成75%伤害。

desc.en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
desc.zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有80%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。

shard.en: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal 40% more damage and heal the target for 40% of the damage Ink Swell deals. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard.zh: 墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加40%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的40%。 驱散类型：弱驱散

desc.en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has 90% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
desc.zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有90%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。

desc.en: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
desc.zh: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。

desc.en: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
desc.zh: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。

scepter.en: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.
scepter.zh: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。

shard.en: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant. The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing 50% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
shard.zh: 额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成50%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

scepter.en: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.
scepter.zh: 共鸣脉冲可以沉默敌人，并获得2点能量点数。

shard.en: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40% impact damage to the landing destination.
shard.zh: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，治疗目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个40%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

desc.en: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to 0 seconds.
desc.zh: 小莫迪吞下一个小兵或一名友方英雄，再朝敌人吐出。单位停留在他肚子里最多可达0秒。

desc.en: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
desc.zh: 小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和眩晕。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。

shard.en: Spear of Mars impales up to 2 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
shard.zh: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多2名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

scepter.en: Lowers cooldown by 10s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 35% of their max health and mana and get a 45% attack damage buff for 20s. This effect stacks.
scepter.zh: 冷却时间降低10秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复35%最大生命值和魔法值，并且获得45%攻击力加成，持续20秒。这个效果可以叠加。

scepter.en: Escape Act has 2 charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
scepter.zh: 逃生技拥有2点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

desc.en: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.
desc.zh: 百戏大王用3束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞0.3秒。

shard.en: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with 50% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by 35% down to a minimum of 215.
shard.zh: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，50%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速35%，移速最低为215。

scepter.en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for 2s after landing.
scepter.zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随2秒。

shard.en: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
shard.zh: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。

scepter.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by 10 seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for 1 seconds. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少10秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续1秒。 驱散类型：弱驱散

scepter.en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases 3 waves of 2 projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter.zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出3波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有2个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

desc.en: Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns enemies and deals 300 + 100% STR damage. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location. Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
desc.zh: 獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和300+100%力量值的伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。 砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

scepter.en: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
scepter.zh: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。

desc.en: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 2.25s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
desc.zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续2.25秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

shard.en: Kez lifesteals 100% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.
shard.zh: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血100%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。

shard.en: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
shard.zh: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

scepter.en: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
scepter.zh: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。

scepter.en: Deals additional 6/10/14 magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.
scepter.zh: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成6/10/14点魔法伤害。

shard.en: Grants 3 temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.
shard.zh: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得3点临时能量。

scepter.en: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
scepter.zh: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

scepter.en: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.
scepter.zh: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有状态抗性。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升75%，水洼的持续时间提升5秒。

shard.en: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
shard.zh: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

scepter.en: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.
scepter.zh: 吸血灵魂变为光环，使友方英雄被击杀时也能变为冥魂。延长冥魂的持续时间。

shard.en: Decreases Cooldown by 10s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance 60% of their max cooldown values.
shard.zh: 冷却时间减少10秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快60%最高冷却时间。

scepter.en: Gains 2 charges with a 20 restore time. Pugna can cast any of his abilities an additional time, consuming an Oblivion Savant charge instead.
scepter.zh: 获得2点能量点数，充能时间为20秒。帕格纳可以额外施放一次他的任意技能，转为消耗一点湮灭专家的能量点数。

scepter.en: Increases bonus movement speed by 15% and attack speed by 70. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
scepter.zh: 移动速度加成提升15%，攻击速度加成提升70。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。

scepter.en: Increases Base Strength Reduction by 0.8.
scepter.zh: 基础力量降低提升0.8。

scepter.en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 20 damage and 3 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
scepter.zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得20点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加3。

shard.en: Liquid Courage can be activated to toss a strong drink to a teammate or yourself to gain the effects of Liquid Courage and 3% Max HP Regen per second. Increases speed increase. Lasts 5 seconds.
shard.zh: 壮胆酒可以主动激活，向队友丢出一杯烈酒，或自己一饮而尽，获得壮胆酒的效果以及每秒3%最大生命值的回复。提升加速效果。 持续5秒。

scepter.en: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
scepter.zh: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

shard.en: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant a M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.
shard.zh: 同归于尽变为主动技能。提升最大魔法值的伤害系数。工程师放置同归于尽木桶后，可以使用子技能手动引爆。同一时间主动技能只能放下一个同归于尽木桶。

shard.en: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.
shard.zh: 使残焰获得献祭心，并且每秒伤害和作用范围提升。

scepter.en: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
scepter.zh: 辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

scepter.en: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within 3 seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown. Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.
scepter.zh: 在使用流派变换后3秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。 施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。

shard.en: Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff. If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.
shard.zh: 只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。 只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。
